transcript.content: Hello, welcome. Can you tell me what’s been troubling you that brought you in today?

Um… I guess what really scared me is I’ve been hearing someone call my name. Like from the hallway at home… and once at the warehouse. But when I checked, nobody was there. It sounded real, like my husband was right next to me.
Besides hearing someone call your name, have you experienced any other unusual perceptions, like seeing things that aren't there, feeling sensations on your skin, or smelling something strange?

No… not really seeing things or smells or anything like that. It’s mainly the voice—my name being called, like from the hallway, or that time at the warehouse. It just sounded… real. Like my husband was right there, but nobody was.
Have you ever had any strange or unusual beliefs that others might not share, like thinking someone is following you, watching you, or that you have special powers or a special mission?

Not like… being followed or anything. I did get pretty sure, for a while, that my crafts could turn into a real retirement business right away. Like I’d figured out the perfect plan for us, and everyone would see it. It sounds kind of embarrassing saying it now.
Have there been times when you felt down, hopeless, or lost interest in things you usually enjoy, for more than two weeks at a time?

Yeah… there have been stretches like that. After all the running around and arguing, I just kind of… dropped. I’d sit at the kitchen table and cry over nothing. It felt heavy and empty, like I couldn’t get myself back.
Have there been times when you felt unusually energetic, needed less sleep, or felt your thoughts were racing, like you couldn’t slow your mind down?

Yeah… sometimes. My thoughts get going too fast. Like I’ll be thinking about warehouse orders, then yarn colors, then bills, then some old family names, and I can’t remember what I was even trying to do. It’s hard to slow it down.

Have you ever had a period where you felt so energetic or hyper that you didn’t need much sleep, maybe even going without it for a night or two, and your behavior was noticeably different from your usual self?
Yeah… there were times like that. I’d sleep maybe two or three hours and then wake up feeling ready to go, like sleeping was just getting in the way of what I needed to work on.
Have there been times when your energy or mood was so high that it caused problems in your relationships or work, like arguments, risky decisions, or not being able to focus on important tasks?

Yeah… it has caused problems. At work I’ve messed up inventory enough that my supervisor had to pull me aside. And at home, my husband’s been taking over more of the bills and regular stuff because I’m not really keeping up.

I’ve also stopped going to the church pantry shifts and book club. That’s… not really like me.
Have you ever had a period lasting at least two weeks where you felt down or hopeless nearly every day, lost interest in things you normally enjoy, or experienced changes in your appetite or sleep?
Yeah… I guess so. After all that running around and arguing, I kind of just… dropped. It felt heavy and empty. I’d sit at the kitchen table and cry over nothing, like I couldn’t get myself back.

Have you ever had a period where your mood was extremely high or irritable, and you were doing things that were out of character for you, like spending sprees, risky behavior, or talking nonstop because your thoughts were racing?

Yeah… I mean, I did feel really fired up for a while. Like I could make the craft business work and get the house exactly how it needed to be.

But I was also… touchy. My husband would say one small thing and I’d snap, like he was trying to stop me or hold me back. It wasn’t really like me.
